walkthroughs.body_html:
Both are compound measures — a rate of one quantity against another.

Density = mass ÷ volume. If 200 g of metal fills 50 cm³, density = 200 ÷ 50 = 4 g/cm³.

Pressure = force ÷ area. A 60 N force on 3 m² gives 60 ÷ 3 = 20 N/m² (= 20 pascals).

Rearrange like speed: mass = density × volume; force = pressure × area.

To decide which deal is best, find the price per unit (per gram, per litre, per item) for each.

Example: 500 g for £3.00 → £3 ÷ 500 = £0.006 per g, i.e. 0.6 p/g.

Compare with: 800 g for £4.40 → £4.40 ÷ 800 = £0.0055 per g, i.e. 0.55 p/g.

The 800 g pack is cheaper per gram → better buy.

If a jumper costs £48 after a 20% discount, what was the original price?

£48 represents (100% − 20%) = 80% of the original. So 80% = £48, meaning 1% = £48 ÷ 80 = £0.60.

Original = 100% = £0.60 × 100 = £60.

Quick check: 20% of £60 = £12, and £60 − £12 = £48. ✓

In a school the ratio of boys to girls is 3:2. There are 30 boys. How many girls are there?
options: There are 60 girls because girls are double the boys.
20 — each part of the ratio represents 10 pupils, so girls = 2 x 10.
There are 27 girls because the ratio 3:2 means subtracting 3 - 2 = 1 from 30 and adding to make 2 girls' part.
Simple interest grows faster than compound because it has fewer steps.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between simple and compound interest?
options: Simple interest is calculated only on the original amount; compound interest is calculated on the original amount plus accumulated interest.
Simple interest grows faster than compound because it has fewer steps.
Simple and compound interest give the same total — compound just uses a different formula.
8 hours, because each worker still has to do the same job.

mcqs.q: If 6 workers take 8 hours to paint a wall, how long would 12 workers take (assuming they work at the same rate)?
options: 16 hours, because doubling the workers doubles everything including the time.
4 hours — this is inverse proportion: double the workers, halve the time.
There are 60 girls because girls are double the boys.
8 hours, because each worker still has to do the same job.
